name: Osia Hyper Retail Limited
summary: Osia Hyper Retail Limited runs the Osia Hypermart chain of hypermarkets in India, selling clothing, footwear, cosmetics, handbags, household accessories, FMCG goods, crockery, handicrafts and handloom items. It operates outlets in Gujarat cities including Ahmedabad and Vadodara, supplied from a central distribution facility in Rakhial. Incorporated in 2013, it was formerly Mapple Exim Limited.
